colorConverter.title: Color Converter
colorConverter.description: Choose a color with 3- or 6-digit HEX, the picker, or RGB/HSL sliders. Copy HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV, and CMYK values, or share a link to the last valid color.

useCases.title: Use Cases
items: Check HEX, RGB, and HSL notation for web design
Copy different notations or share a link to the same valid color
Use approximate CMYK values as a reference and verify the print workflow separately
Keep an incomplete draft while checking the last valid color

whatIs.title: What is the Color Converter?
whatIs.description: Convert 3- or 6-digit opaque HEX into RGB, HSL, HSV, and CMYK values. A picker, presets, and RGB/HSL sliders also select colors. Incomplete input remains in place while the last valid color stays visible; failed copies offer manual selection and retry.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: 1. Enter 3 or 6 HEX digits, with an optional #. RGB/HSL strings and transparency are not supported.
2. You can also use the picker, presets, or RGB/HSL sliders. Selecting a color updates the HEX field.
3. Incomplete input keeps the last valid color. Edit the draft or choose Restore last color.
4. Copy the format you need. If copying fails, select its complete value or retry.
5. The share link reproduces the displayed valid color, excluding your input draft.

tips.title: Tips
items: Copy RGB/HSL notation from the results for CSS; this tool does not parse those strings as input.
CMYK values are approximate conversions, not a guarantee for a particular ink, paper, or printer profile.
Alpha, #RGBA/#RRGGBBAA, CSS variables, and color names are outside this input format.

items.q: What is the difference between 3-digit and 6-digit HEX codes?
items.a: #RGB is shorthand for #RRGGBB. For example, #F0A equals #FF00AA. The shorthand is only valid when each channel is a repeated pair of identical digits.

items.q: Do CMYK values guarantee the printed color?
items.a: No. These are reference values calculated from RGB, without ICC color management or a printer profile. Actual output depends on ink, paper, and device settings and needs a separate check in the print workflow.

items.q: Why does the same HEX code look different across browsers?
items.a: Differences in monitor color profiles (sRGB, Display P3, etc.) and calibration can cause the same value to appear differently. Use a color management system (CMS) for design work that requires consistency.

items.q: Why are results still visible when my input is invalid?
items.a: The draft and the last valid color are kept separately. While the error notice is visible, preview, copying, and sharing use the last valid color stated in that notice. Edit the draft or restore that color.

items.q: Can I enter RGB strings or transparent colors?
items.a: The text field accepts only 3- or 6-digit HEX, with an optional #. The picker and RGB/HSL sliders are available, but RGB/HSL strings, alpha, color names, and CSS variables are not parsed.

input.label: HEX color code
input.hint: Enter a 3- or 6-digit HEX code. The # is optional. Transparency and CSS color expressions are not supported.
input.invalid: Enter 3 or 6 hexadecimal digits using 0–9 and A–F.
input.lastValid: The input is not valid yet. The preview and conversions still show the last valid color, {hex}.
input.sliderHint: Choosing a color with a slider also replaces the HEX input with that color.

copy.failed: Automatic copying failed. Select the value below to copy it, or try again.
copy.selectionFailed: Automatic selection failed. Select the value below manually.

query.invalid: The color in this link could not be read. Check the displayed color or enter a new one.
query.writeFailed: The address could not be updated. Copying and sharing use the displayed color.

share.label: Color conversions
share.notice: Sharing uses the displayed valid color, {hex}. Your input draft is not included in the link.
share.cmykNote: CMYK values are calculated references and do not guarantee printed colors.
